newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Ergo, AMP cut NZ variable mortgage rate to 8.25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Ergo, AMP cut NZ variable mortgage rate to 8.25 pct.

text.p: Telephone bank Ergo and its fund manager parent, AMP Society, on Tuesday cut their variable home mortgage lending rates to 8.25 percent from 8.95 percent.

Ergo Managing Director Graham Meyer said Ergo had cut its fixed one-year lending rate to 8.75 percent from 8.95 percent, the two-year rate to 9.35 percent from 9.6 percent and the three year rate to 9.5 percent from 9.75 percent.
Meyer said the cuts reflected falls in wholesale yields. Today's employment data had given him confidence that wholesale yields would remain at, or below, their current range, he added.
